title: Furka · Grimsel · Susten Big Three Dawn

story: Three alpine legends, best before the traffic wakes up. 223 km round from Altdorf - plan on about 4 h 17 of riding. title: Klausen · Pragel · Walensee Precision Loop
slogan: Two passes and 240 km, high point 0 m
story: Forest shade, limestone walls and a hard look at weather. 240 km round from Glarus - plan on about 4 h 35 of riding. The stops in between: Altdorf and Walensee view stop. The climbs: Klausenpass and Pragelpass high road. It tops out at about 1,950 m. Klausen Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.

title: Susten · Grimsel · Furka Triple Crown
slogan: 3 passes in 223 km
story: Cold alpine dawn, three big passes, no wasted kilometres. A 223 km loop that starts and ends near Altdorf, about 4 h 17 of riding. The climbs: Sustenpass west, Grimselpass and Furkapass glacier road. It tops out at about 2,450 m. Susten Pass, Grimsel Pass and Furka Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.

title: Hirzel · Einsiedeln · Sihlsee Sunset Run
slogan: A 81 km loop out of Hirzel sweepers
story: Short enough after work, good enough to remember. 81 km round from Horgen - plan on about 1 h 33 of riding. It goes by way of Einsiedeln monastery stop, Sihlsee water stop and Zug lakeside. Ratenpass is the high point. It tops out at about 1,450 m. It is a high-mountain day.
